query:
SELECT c.name, EXISTS (
                 SELECT 1 FROM json_each(c.match_names) a JOIN json_each(?) b
                 ON a.value = b.value
               ) AS "matched!: bool"
               FROM candidate_profile p JOIN candidate c ON c.id = p.candidate_id
               WHERE p.crawl_id = ? AND p.url = ? ORDER BY c.id
